summary: Danaher Corporation and subsidiary DH Masi Finance Inc. entered into a note purchase and guaranty agreement on June 3, 2026, to issue CHF 850,870,000 aggregate principal amount of senior notes across four series (Series A due 2031 at 1.65%, Series B due 2033 at 1.88%, Series C due 2036 at 2.10%, and Series D due 2039 at 2.25%) to institutional accredited investors. The filing is a routine debt financing under Items 2.03 and 8.01 of Form 8-K, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual deal mechanics are disclosed. This transaction is a standard capital markets debt raise, not a special situation.
